text:
**Verdict: ready with changes.** The missing launcher, two execution paths and current role defaults are correctly identified. The main corrections concern measured yield, campaign termination and acceptance authority. No files were modified.

Keep **`shiploop-e2e-iterate`**. It matches “iteration” and “qualified iteration,” avoids collisions with Improve, and distinguishes this harness from ShipLoop itself. Use *exploration round* for discovery, *qualified cycle* for one candidate comparison, and *campaign* for the continuing effort. “Closed loop” describes the behavior. The argument against “self-improve” is weaker: self-improving systems can contain separate evaluators.

Prioritized changes:

1. **Correct the factual summary.**

| Draft claim | Verified correction |
|---|---|
| Ledger states: 8 open, 3 admitted, etc. | **24 records, 76 events: 9 owner, 6 deferred, 4 admitted, 2 open, 2 verified, 1 refuted.** Events must be folded chronologically, not by physical JSONL order. Four admitted does not mean four selectable candidates; selection also filters target, materiality, exposure and case. [learning_records.py — current/select](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/test/shiploop_e2e/learning_records.py:175) |
| Two promotions demonstrate low improvement throughput | The five decision events across three records are correctly counted, all on **`hello-hook-continuation`**. But one promotion restored a deliberately broken capability, and its final decision was recorded manually after reassessment. These are not two autonomous discoveries. [learning-records.jsonl — restoration decision](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/test/shiploop_e2e/learning-records.jsonl:47) |
| Worktree per iteration; final candidate always unevaluated | One worktree **per invocation**, reused across iterations. Final status is `unevaluated` **or** `comparison_required`. [iterate.py — main](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/test/shiploop_e2e/iterate.py:361), [result serialization](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/test/shiploop_e2e/iterate.py:514) |
| Every qualified cycle includes another style | A generality case is optional; omitting it limits the qualification claim. [SPEC.md — Qualified iteration](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/test/shiploop_e2e/SPEC.md:837) |
| Reviewer receives only three commit messages | It also receives substantive comparison/source-history anchors. Ordinary review lacks an explicit historical comparator, but promotion separately compares registered arms; efficiency promotion is not decided from one run. [review.py — last_commit_messages](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/test/shiploop_e2e/review.py:254) |
| Prediction already names stage | Its effects contain exactly `case`, `measure`, `direction`, `at_least`; there is no stage or instrument field. Use existing `next_experiment` prose initially. [prediction.py — validate](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/test/shiploop_e2e/prediction.py:67) |

Also correct the bundled harness count to **114 tracked files**, including at `7fb5ba64`. Candidate paths include ShipLoop tests/fixtures. Withholding is not filesystem isolation; unnamed reads and Git objects remain possible. Claude’s `env()` also does not isolate HOME. [boundary.py — candidate prefixes](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/test/shiploop_e2e/boundary.py:35), [SPEC.md — isolation limits](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/test/shiploop_e2e/SPEC.md:674), [hosts.py — ClaudeHost.env](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/test/shiploop_e2e/hosts.py:404)

2. **Make the campaign contract the skill’s central responsibility.**

The draft omits an existing, decisive requirement: **a script stop does not establish campaign convergence**. Caps, two non-promotions, empty findings and missing measurements end an invocation; the operator must inspect the full backlog and coverage before choosing the next useful authorized investigation. Existing limits must neither be silently adopted as success criteria nor evaded. [SPEC.md — Campaign operator directive](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/test/shiploop_e2e/SPEC.md:1117)

“Deeply inspect every stage/file/journal” is also an unmet requirement, not an existing guarantee. `review.validity()` validates process and response structure. Have the skill record exercised stages, inspected artifacts, omissions and unknowns using existing evidence; avoid another elaborate gate. [review.py — validity](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/test/shiploop_e2e/review.py:390)

3. **Reorder effectiveness around useful decisions per unit of effort.**

My ranking is **backlog reconciliation → cheapest discriminating instrument → coverage/comparators → selective advice → delivery**.

First, reconcile records with shipped fixes and prior decisions. Then prioritize consequential, recurring problems with a plausible generic remedy. The current selector ranks confidence then age, not expected benefit versus investigation cost. [learning_records.py — select](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/test/shiploop_e2e/learning_records.py:238)

Move your instrument proposal to the top. Crucially, cheap must still preserve the causal context: E25’s isolated document-stage pilot failed to reproduce the real problem; reading upstream knowledge and stopping real runs after discovery found the missing capture. [E25 — results and limits](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/docs/experiments/house-style-records-20261115/README.md:8)

Move coverage rotation above standing panels. Choose contrasting cases from actual gaps. Supply `facts.md` and comparators using existing matching rules—case/host/model alone is insufficient; effort, prompt, planning mode, build and measurement validity matter. [SPEC.md — comparison sample](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/test/shiploop_e2e/SPEC.md:1415)

Reject a two-pass, four-seat panel **per owner-held record** as the default. Investigate first; use one strong advisor for a concrete unresolved decision, expanding when disagreement warrants it. Calibrate judgment quality before multiplying judges, consistent with [Anthropic’s evaluation guidance](https://www.anthropic.com/research/demystifying-evals-for-ai-agents).

Add the missing productivity denominator: accepted, demonstrated generic improvements per **total campaign hours/tokens**, including exploration, failed candidates, reviews and verification. Report effect size and apparatus learning separately; promotion counts alone encourage trivial wins.

4. **Narrow the calibration and publication claims.**

The calibration figures are accurate **for Terra/high, ShipLoop 1.27.0 and two cases**. The 27.7–35.7% false-call rates do not establish that most present verdicts are wrong. Narrowing the digest cannot establish applicability to Grok/xhigh; the loader currently checks scoring compatibility but not driver compatibility. Preserve this calibration and obtain applicable evidence when an efficiency claim requires it. [Calibration — scope and limits](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/docs/experiments/e2e-calibration-20261031/README.md:54), [cycle.py — _load_calibration](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/test/shiploop_e2e/cycle.py:129)

D4 already has an every-attempt-review policy; **changing** it remains open. “38 sessions” is structural arithmetic; “two hours” is an old estimate.

Replace “only qualify mode produces code that can land” with **“candidates require appropriate acceptance evidence.”** Hand-built qualification and narrowly evidenced fixes exist. PROMOTE can also leave an `unexplained_gain`; it does not complete delivery. [prediction.py — outcome](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/test/shiploop_e2e/prediction.py:203)

Routine: authorized investigation, equivalent repairs, and release/host refresh after required checks. Owner decisions: changed acceptance tolerances, review sampling, calibration scope, comparability-breaking defaults, product trade-offs, loop limits and external deployments. Preserve existing authorization; do not add repeated permission checkpoints. Keep promotion, merge, release and published verification distinct. [AGENTS.md — authority](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/AGENTS.md:55), [SPEC.md — milestones](/Users/dadleet/src/skill-craft/test/shiploop_e2e/SPEC.md:36)

5. **Keep the seam conceptual; defer extraction.**

The split is directionally right, but current modules contain ShipLoop assumptions. “Generic parts must not import ShipLoop names” would itself initiate generalization.

Document this prospective adapter:

| Adapter operation | Supplies |
|---|---|
| `contract()` | Mission, obligations, editable paths, withheld inputs, authority |
| `build(revision)` | Runnable subject artifact and immutable identity |
| `run(case, build, profile, instrument)` | Execution handle, receipts and resource ownership |
| `observe(run)` | Stage/artifact index, outcomes, costs and explicit unknowns |
| `evaluate(run, frozen_contract)` | Quality floors, measures, validity and provenance |
| `cleanup(resources)` | Ownership-scoped cleanup evidence |
| `deliver(candidate, acceptance)` | Subject-specific integration/release actions |

Generic orchestration can own registration, roles, ledger and decisions. ShipLoop supplies packaging, stage semantics, S-clauses, fixtures and release policy. Build a thin skill bound to an explicit checkout now; extract only when a real second subject demonstrates the shared requirements.
